# 佛說不增不減經

**ID:** T0668
**Volume:** T16
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 經集部
**Byline:** 元魏 菩提流支譯
**Dynasty:** 元魏
**Date:** 525
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T0668

## Contributors
- 菩提流支 (A001357)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T668 in one fascicle is one of the principal short *tathāgatagarbha* sūtras, transmitted into Chinese by [菩提流支](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8F%A9%E6%8F%90%E6%B5%81%E6%94%AF) of the Northern Wèi. The text takes up the question of whether the realm of beings (*sattvadhātu* 眾生界) increases or decreases over time — i.e., whether buddhahood removes beings from the round of saṃsāra. The Buddha's reply is "neither increase nor decrease" (不增不減): the realm of beings, the *dharma-dhātu* and the *tathāgata-garbha* are non-different in nature; what looks like decrease through liberation is in fact the manifestation of the originally pure tathāgatagarbha, which neither increases nor decreases.

**Abstract**

The attribution to [菩提流支](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8F%A9%E6%8F%90%E6%B5%81%E6%94%AF) (Bodhiruci, d. c. 527) is unanimous in the Chinese catalogues (*Lìdài sānbǎo jì*, *Kāiyuán lù*). Date bracket follows Bodhiruci's documented translation activity at the Northern Wèi capital Luòyáng (508–527). The Sanskrit original is lost, but a Tibetan recension exists that confirms the doctrinal coherence of Bodhiruci's translation.

T668 is a key witness to the early-sixth-century stage of *tathāgatagarbha* doctrine: the identification of *tathāgatagarbha* with *dharma-dhātu* anticipates the central thesis of the *Ratnagotravibhāga* (taken into Chinese as the *Bǎoxìng lùn* 寶性論, T1611). The text is brief — about 13 columns of Taishō text — but doctrinally dense, and it was extensively cited by later Chinese *tathāgatagarbha* exegetes including [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) and the early Chán tradition.

Related canonical texts: T1611 (寶性論 / *Ratnagotravibhāga*), with which T668 shares its conceptual core; [KR6i0323](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0323) (大方等如來藏經 / T666) and [KR6i0326](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0326) (佛說無上依經 / T669), the cognate *tathāgatagarbha* sūtras.
